scope: Independent read-only follow-up scope investigation for g1-glm-B18 / g1-kimi-B11. No implementation, no model call, no admission or change to the three reviewed packages.

evidence.fact: init reads JSON profiles from --profiles and passes them to sample.initialize.
validate_profiles enforces role-to-runtime, tools names, executable/entry hashes, budgets, model and supervisor template. No per-file write scope field is validated.
Profiles are stored unchanged in config; dispatch passes the role profile unchanged through invoke. No path scope is derived.
workspace/feature.py restriction exists in model prompt and declared artifact check, not in permission profile.

invoke calls adapters.command with profile/prompt/session and then run_bounded with cwd. Adapter command has no cwd argument; current invoke can transparently carry additional profile fields without signature change.
command uses tools for both --tools and single comma-token --allowedTools; Write/Edit presence selects acceptEdits. Parse checks tool names only, not file_path.
Existing implementation_digest and config_digest bind code/config and reject drift; no separate policy registry is needed.
Existing profile contract enumerates tools but not per-file permissions; sample owns fixed workflow and implementing feature. Frozen interface requires a successor clarification.
Permissions belong to profile; writers require isolated worktrees and explicit write sets. This is contract, not present permission implementation.
ExecutionProfile binds permissions, RuntimeAdapter consumes authorized profile/capabilities; changed profile creates a new binding.
permission_policy_ref is proposed only, no live parser or authoritative per-file policy implementation.
Historical package ownership: P2 adapters/runtime/test_runtime; P6 sample/checks/gates/test_sample/test_flow/test_gates.

minimum_scope_recommendation.decision_owner: Interface integrator must decide successor profile permission field and P2/P6 boundary before package admission; current findings explicitly scope_needs_alignment.
minimum_scope_recommendation.policy_owner: P6 sample is sole owner of fixed sample role write scope (implement: workspace/feature.py; reviewer/supervisor: no writes). Do not hardcode role/file in generic adapter.
minimum_scope_recommendation.serialization_owner: P2 adapters is sole owner of profile-to-CLI translation, including dontAsk and separate argv rules; generic runtime remains a transparent process boundary unless reviewed contract requires otherwise.
minimum_scope_recommendation.implementation_approach_not_approved: Extend existing profile with typed per-file permission data, validate/derive from fixed sample authority, bind resolved inputs in existing config digest, and serialize absolute per-file Write/Edit rules. Missing/invalid/broadened writer scope must fail before launch. Preserve invoke/command signatures by supplying resolved profile rather than duplicating scheduler or policy registry.
minimum_scope_recommendation.open_choice: Exact field name/schema and whether supplied declaration must equal fixed policy or is derived by sample initialization are not yet specified; choose one authority, not two mutable sources.

reusable_tests.extension: AdapterCommandTests: separate argv tokens, exact absolute Write/Edit, dontAsk, no acceptEdits/bypass/generic Write/Edit allow; missing/invalid scope rejects. Existing tests only identity/list/max_turns.
Existing post-hoc tool-name rejection and invoke hash/launch-boundary tests remain regressions, not evidence of file-scope enforcement.

Profiles fixture and mocked invoke call capture: assert initialized/frozen role permissions and handoff to runtime; reject expanded writer/read-only-role write scope before dispatch. Current mock bypasses actual adapter and cannot prove CLI permissions.
Reuse config tamper and implementation version invalidation for scope binding, not new config/state ledger.
Reuse paths.checked traversal/absolute/symlink/junction rejection; do not copy path validator.

write_set_independence.R-log: Independent of checks.py + test_gates.py if following recommended write set; shared final candidate/digest revalidation still needed.
write_set_independence.R-junction: Product files independent, test write set NOT independent because AdapterCommandTests and junction test both live in tests/test_runtime.py. Prefer queue after R-junction exact frozen delivery/released claim. Do not dispatch parallel same-file authors.
write_set_independence.alternative_not_admitted: A reviewed move of existing AdapterCommandTests into a sole test_adapters owner can later separate responsibility, but requires updating/removing original ownership and coordinating test_runtime; do not create duplicate command tests just to claim independent writes.

unknowns: Product profile per-file schema and exact resolved binding contract are not decided.
Actual CLI/native positive-negative enforcement of future product argv has not been tested; bootstrap probe does not prove product path.
Hook/session/plugin bypass and host side effects remain existing limited-evidence boundaries; no OS sandbox/global memory isolation claim.
No new tests or model calls were run in this scope inquiry.
